---
name: Bug report
about: Report something that isn't working as expected
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Describe the bug

A clear description of what the bug is.

## Steps to reproduce

Explain how to reproduce the behavior, step by step.

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen instead.

## Environment

Include the Arix version or commit, deployment method (Docker Compose or local dev), LLM provider in use, Node version, and OS.

## Logs

Paste any relevant server logs. Remember to redact secrets, tokens, WooCommerce credentials, and customer data before pasting.

## Additional context

Anything else that would help diagnose the issue, such as screenshots.
